=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:512-515 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers`, the `select(($seen | index(.)) == null)` gate evaluates `.` against `$seen` instead of the current `$req` element, so the check-runs fetch gate is wrong.
  WHY: The check-runs fetch is skipped or run at the wrong times, depending on the reviewer. Reviewers disagreed on severity (MAJOR/BLOCKER) and on the failure direction. Claude-sonnet-5_5 says a non-empty `$seen` skips the fetch and gives false "(missing)" blockers. Others say the fetch always runs, and a failed redundant fetch returns 2 and makes the caller fail open to a merge attempt. Highest severity is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13883-13890 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The refusal-detail awk anchor `/^::error::gh command failed after /` matches only gh_retry's retry-exhaustion path, so non-retryable paths record warning scaffolding and percent-escaped stderr in `final_merge_error`.
  WHY: The tracking comment can show garbled text instead of GitHub's refusal reason. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini) vs NIT (the others); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT at confidence 2 and said it could not verify the non-retryable path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13887-13890 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `head -c 600` can split a multi-byte UTF-8 character when capping the refusal message.
  WHY: A dangling continuation byte is left at the end of the capped string.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13754 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When `declare -F _pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers` fails (e.g. version skew), the logic defers to the merge attempt without any diagnostic.
  WHY: The operator cannot tell why the gate was bypassed.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:513 (performance consequence) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Because the gate is always true, every `mergeable_state=blocked` poll makes an unnecessary check-runs call.
  WHY: This is a rate-limit cost during the ineligibility window. It is a consequence of the same defect as finding 1 and was reported separately under PERFORMANCE.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:513 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `.` inside `index(.)` is evaluated against `$seen`, so the expression is `$seen | index($seen)`. With non-empty `$seen` the check-runs fetch is skipped and `$runs` stays `[]`. With empty `$seen` the fetch always runs.
  WHY: A required context satisfied only by a check-run is reported as `<ctx> (missing)`. `finalize_integration_merge_if_needed` then sets `FINAL_MERGE_BUDGET_ELIGIBLE=0` and returns 1 before `gh pr merge`. `_check_final_merge_ineligibility_alert` names the wrong blockers. The new tests miss it. A second effect is a redundant check-runs call, which returns 2 on failure and makes the caller fail open.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~13883-13890 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: This is the refusal-detail awk anchor in `finalize_integration_merge_if_needed`. The reviewer did not verify the non-retryable `gh_retry` path.
  WHY: The anchor works on the exhaustion paths (gh_helpers.sh:1236-1239 and 1319-1322). The effect is cosmetic wording only.
- HARDENING: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:513 — fix `[$req[] | . as $c | select(($seen | index($c)) == null)] | length > 0` and add a test with `statuses: [{context: "other", state: "success"}]` plus a check-run-backed required context.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `_check_final_merge_ineligibility_alert` — for `ruleset:` blockers, the resolution text points at `ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS`, which does not override rulesets. Add one sentence. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:512-515 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5

  WHY: The condition is true even when required contexts are present in commit statuses, causing redundant check-runs calls. If those calls fail, the lookup returns 2 and the caller fails open to a merge that should be blocked.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13883-13890 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

  WHY: On non-retryable paths, `final_merge_error` and the tracking comment contain retry noise and percent-escaped text.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13887-13890 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `head -c 600` can split a multi-byte UTF-8 character.
  WHY: A dangling continuation byte is left at the end of the capped string.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13754 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When `declare -F _pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers` fails, the logic defers to the merge attempt without a diagnostic.
  WHY: The operator cannot tell why the gate was bypassed.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:513 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `index(.)` evaluates against `$seen`, so `select` never filters and the check-runs API is fetched on every call.
  WHY: This breaks the §15 contract at lines 469-473. A transient failure of the redundant fetch at line 515 returns 2, and the caller at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13756-13765 fails open to a merge attempt. The author's own code at lines 523-538 uses the correct `as $var` pattern, as do label_helpers.sh:271, review_rb_judge.sh:996, pr_checks_lib.sh:675 and unblock_judge.sh:1848. The fix is `[$req[] | . as $ctx | select(($seen | index($ctx)) == null)] | length > 0`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13884-13886 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The awk anchor matches only the retry-exhaustion line (gh_helpers.sh:1236 and :1319). On the non-retryable path (gh_helpers.sh:1203-1209, :1288-1296) the `::warning::` lines and percent-escaped stderr are not stripped.
  WHY: For a 403/422 from `gh pr merge`, `final_merge_error` and the tracking comment get warning scaffolding and percent escapes instead of GitHub's reason text.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:513 (PERFORMANCE) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Every `mergeable_state=blocked` poll makes one extra `GET commits/<sha>/check-runs?per_page=100` call, and `--paginate` adds a round-trip per page.
  WHY: This is a real rate-limit cost (§15) over a 6h ineligibility window.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1631-1633 and 1618 — the resolution text still advises `ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS`, which does not govern ruleset blockers. Add a one-line note. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13755 — when `_pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers` is missing, the gate is skipped silently. Add a warning, and mirror it at line 1602. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13890 — `head -c 600` can split a UTF-8 character. Replace it or strip the trailing bytes. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:512-515 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `index(.)` is evaluated against `$seen`, so it returns null and selects every required context. The check-runs request is made even when all required contexts already have commit statuses.
  WHY: tests/test_orchestrate_final_merge_required_checks_gate.py:929-930 expects no such request and will fail. If the request fails, the helper returns 2 before reporting the known failing status, and the caller fails open and spends a merge attempt.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:512-514 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The gate `[(.statuses // [])[] | .context] as $seen | [$req[] | select(($seen | index(.)) == null)] | length > 0` does not test membership of the current `$req` element. It is always true when `$req` is non-empty, so the `--paginate --slurp` check-runs fetch at line 515 runs on every call.
  WHY: This costs an extra paginated call per invocation. If the fetch fails, line 515 returns 2 and orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13763-13765 fails open and attempts the merge despite a known failing status. The alert path (1604-1607) drops the ruleset blockers on rc=2. The test at tests/test_orchestrate_final_merge_required_checks_gate.py:919-931 asserts no `/check-runs` call and cannot hold. Fix: `[$req[] as $ctx | select(($seen | index($ctx)) == null)] | length > 0`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13883-13890 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The awk anchor resets the buffer only on gh_retry's retry-exhaustion path (gh_helpers.sh:1236). On the non-retryable path (gh_helpers.sh:1203-1209), `merge_err` carries `::warning::` lines and percent-escaped stderr.
  WHY: `final_merge_error` and the "Final merge blocked" comment can show percent-encoded text. It only triggers when stderr matches a permanent-failure marker (e.g. HTTP 422, gh_helpers.sh:194). The #579-style GraphQL refusal lands on the retry path where the anchor works.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1618 and 1630-1633 — the alert offers `ORCH_FINAL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS`, which cannot clear a ruleset blocker. Add a line saying so.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:13890 — `head -c 600` can split a multi-byte UTF-8 character. Strip the incomplete trailing sequence. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
